newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet fuel flat, but good supply pressures.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet fuel flat, but good supply pressures.

text.p: NWE jet fuel oil was flat on Thursday as healthy supply amid slack demand continued to weigh on the market, traders said.
Some jet material traded at July IPE +$14.50 fob ARA which left outright prices little changed from Wednesday's levels when they were assessed around June IPE +$15.50/$16.50 fob ARA.
Traders said continued good availability and low demand were continuing to pressure the market.

"There's really not too much demand," said one trader. "You can't put the excess into low sulphur production because that market's down as well, they whole situation is pretty slack." -- London Newsroom, +44 171 542 7714
